description: Returns the performance data of one drill-string item: pipe body (new and premium torsional and tensile yield, internal pressure, collapse), tool joint (outside and inside diameter, make-up torque, drift, torsional yield) and assembly values. Identifiers are given by list_drill_pipe, for example dp-5-19.50-s135-nc50.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

name: get_drill_pipe_specs

source_url.description: Address of the page on which the data is published

title: Drill-string item: performance data
